GB.name: Met Office SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
GB.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

PL.name: IMGW-PIB SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
PL.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

DE.name: Deutscher Wetterdienst / official SYNOP gauges
DE.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

SK.name: SHMÚ SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
SK.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

LU.name: MeteoLux / Luxembourg-Findel SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
LU.period: Luxembourg-Findel SYNOP gauge. Currently reports 6- and 12-hour precipitation; 24 and 48 hours require complete adjacent intervals. No hourly total is inferred from these longer reports.

IE.name: Met Éireann / official hourly rain gauges
IE.period: Met Éireann total hourly rainfall in mm, excluding event-driven tips. Complete measured hours are required for longer totals.

NL.name: KNMI / hourly precipitation and official SYNOP gauges
NL.period: KNMI RH hourly archive in 0.1 mm, converted to mm, supplemented with current KNMI SYNOP precipitation distributed by DWD. Identical station IDs are merged. Hour 24 ends at midnight UTC; traces below 0.05 mm are flagged. Native longer intervals are retained without inventing hourly totals.

BE.name: Royal Meteorological Institute / RMI-KMI gauges
BE.period: RMI/KMI precipitation in mm for each ten-minute interval. All six samples are required for a completed clock hour; near-real-time observations are provisional.

CZ.name: Czech Hydrometeorological Institute / ČHMÚ
CZ.period: ČHMÚ SRA1H hourly precipitation in mm with UTC observation times. Quality 0 and provisional 5 accepted; suspect, estimated and missing observations excluded.
